canonical_equations: Exact integer d2; select up to K sources by (d2,index); exact coincidence returns source value; otherwise ordered RN32 sum(value/RN32(d2))/sum(1/RN32(d2)).
input_contract: encoding=binary32-hex; sources[M,2],queries[Q,2] uint ticks0..32767; unique sources,M1..256,Q1..4096; values[M] finite f32,valid[M]uint0/1; neighbors1..16; M*Q*K<=4194304; finite RN32 intermediates.
output_contract: Q x [u32 status,f32 value,u32 contributors,nearest_d2]; status1 no valid source with remaining fields0; status0 success; nearest distance exact; no variance or large-hole reconstruction guarantee.
result_contract: Q x [u32 status,f32 value,u32 contributors,nearest_d2]; status1 no valid source with remaining fields0; status0 success; nearest distance exact; no variance or large-hole reconstruction guarantee.
precision_requirements: Finite IEEE binary32 values, explicitly supplied as eight hex digits (encoding=binary32-hex). Every +,-,*,/,sqrt rounds to nearest ties-to-even; gradual underflow; canonical positive zero after arithmetic. No FMA or reassociation. Nonfinite inputs, intermediate overflow, division by zero and invalid roots reject the job on CPU before dispatch. Bit identity is to this specified rounded algorithm, not exact real arithmetic or other library reduction orders.
validation_method: Full byte comparison against independent exact-rational RN32 CPU oracle; analytic, adversarial and held-out vectors; arithmetic tested separately.
